title: Diagnose and fix why CI (GitHub Actions, linux job) keeps failing on master
objective: Owner reports CI on master keeps failing ('sempre da pau'), pasting a GitHub notification for a failed run (commit eb63f2a, 'linux' job, failed in 59 seconds). Investigate the actual failure via gh CLI (run logs/annotations) before changing anything, since the repo has accumulated substantial local changes this session (Storybook, packages/ui reorg, architecture-studio Next.js migration) that were never committed/pushed -- the CI failure predates or is independent of today's local work and needs its own root-cause investigation.
validations: DONE: gh CLI is not installed in this environment (confirmed via both Bash and PowerShell) and GitHub's public REST API returns 404 for this repo (private, no auth available) -- root-caused the failure by reproducing .github/workflows/ci.yml's linux job step-by-step locally instead, in the exact order the workflow runs them.

DONE: found and fixed 3 independent, real CI-breaking issues, none related to this session's uncommitted Storybook/Next.js work: (1) packages/ui/tests/snapshots/public-api.md was stale after the earlier @default-tag additions (UI-STORYBOOK-DEFAULT-VALUES task) -- regenerated via UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=yes, diff confirmed to be exactly those additions; (2) docs/generated/grafting.graph.json was stale after this session's file reorganization (data-table.tsx move, index.ts becoming a pure re-export barrel, etc.) -- regenerated via `pnpm run graph:extract`, node/edge counts stable (88/86) before and after; (3) a real bug in tools/scripts/check-typescript-public-api.mjs's expandLocalReExports: it used statement.getText(sourceFile) instead of getFullText(sourceFile) for directly-declared statements, which silently stripped every such statement's own leading JSDoc comment from the tracked baseline -- this went undetected because packages/ui became 100% re-exports this session (never hits that code path), but corrupted the x6-canvas and three-canvas baselines the moment they were regenerated. Fixed the source line, regenerated both baselines, confirmed via diff that only cosmetic blank-line differences remained and every comment was restored.

DONE: added a regression test (tools/scripts/check-typescript-public-api.test.mjs, 'baseline rendering keeps each directly-declared statement's own leading JSDoc comment') exercising expandLocalReExports's direct-declaration branch directly, and confirmed it actually catches the regression class -- temporarily reverted the source fix, reran, watched the new test fail with the exact stripped-comment symptom, then restored the fix and reran clean (7/7 pass).

DONE: reproduced every step of .github/workflows/ci.yml's single 'linux' job locally, in order, and confirmed each passes: `cargo check --workspace`; `cargo test --workspace` (all suites, 0 failures); the 'TypeScript behavior contracts' step (agent-task-guard, research-registry-reminder, check-third-party-notices, third-party-attribution-reminder test files, check-third-party-notices.mjs itself, nx x6-canvas:check/test, nx ui:check/test/api-check); `pnpm run docs:check` (graph:map/manifest/extract:check, docs:api:ts/rust:check, graph-core:api-check, x6-canvas:api-check); `nx run engine-domain-core:check`; `uv lock --check && uv sync --locked`; `uv run --package automation pytest` (4 passed). No step reached that wasn't already covered above.

DONE: confirmed docs/generated/api/ts/three-canvas.api.md was never actually touched by this investigation (git diff --stat showed no change to it) -- removed it from affected_paths; the six files actually modified match `git status --short` exactly.
artifacts: tools/scripts/check-typescript-public-api.mjs (expandLocalReExports: getText -> getFullText fix for directly-declared statements)
tools/scripts/check-typescript-public-api.test.mjs (new regression test for the getText/getFullText comment-stripping bug, expandLocalReExports exported for direct unit testing)
packages/ui/tests/snapshots/public-api.md (regenerated to catch up with the earlier @default-tag additions)
docs/generated/grafting.graph.json (regenerated to catch up with this session's file moves)
risks: This investigation only proves the linux CI job's own steps pass against the current working tree -- none of this session's substantial uncommitted local changes (Storybook, packages/ui reorg, architecture-studio Next.js migration, this fix itself) have been committed or pushed yet, so the actual GitHub Actions run will still fail until they are.
